measurement.A: validated against motion capture or a pressure walkway in a clinical population with one 2D camera
measurement.B: validated in healthy adults only, or with a different single camera setup
measurement.C: no direct validation; derived from landmarks that are themselves acceptable
measurement.D: shown to be unreliable; never used

gate.rule: no -> not offered; without_aid or with_aid -> continue

gate.item: pc_walk_10m (asked on the day's one screen when a walk is planned)

gate.rule: only with the prosthesis on (the day's question day_prosthesis_ask yes); never on crutches without a prosthesis

gate.item: recent surgery to the back, hip, knee, ankle or foot not cleared (the body map of the intake, surgery_not_cleared; pc_surgery_recent is no longer asked, D-032)

gate.rule: stroke or SCI: no gait test (reason clearance_needed), as the global gate (review A17); the named exception (overground only, helper, short walk, never the pad) was not adopted at the sign off (GAIT-Q1: keep the gate). Other conditions: overground allowed; walking pad not offered

today.item: day_worry_ask yes (the day's one yes or no question; it replaces pc_urgent, pc_unwell, pc_change and the region red flags)
today.action: the whole check is skipped today (postpone, next day lock); one calm screen with a way to the emergency screen (D-032)

today.item: leg, hip or back pain 6 or more today (the day's pain question, day_pain_ask)
today.action: postpone the gait test (review A08: one shared rule, skip at 6 or more)

today.item: leg, hip or back pain 4 or 5 today
today.action: test runs; only the antalgic label can be shown and the weakness and tightness contributors are suppressed (review A08)

today.item: pain 6 to 8 today in an area that is not a leg, hip or back (the day's pain question)
day_unsteady_ask yes (a fall in the past year, unsteadiness or a worry about falling: the STEADI three in one question)
an aid in the intake (walking with_aid)
today.action: helper required; walk with the usual aid; pad not offered

today.item: pc_pd_freezing yes (Parkinson's only, asked on the day's one screen)
today.action: helper required; pad not offered; turns slow and wide

today.item: Parkinson's: dizziness on standing (pc_pd_dizzy_standing) is no longer asked (D-032)
today.action: pad not offered with Parkinson's; overground as the other rows decide

today.item: day_helper_ask («هل معك أحد اليوم؟»), asked once at home when someone beside the person changes the day: a helper rule, or the pad
today.action: no -> the parts that need a helper are skipped (helper_needed), and no pad; staff count as helper at the booth

today.item: knee orthosis (KAFO or a locked knee brace) on a side
today.action: recorded; stiff knee not assessed on that side (knee_orthosis_on_S, review A14)

today.item: not asked in the focus check since D-032: pc_pain_worse, pc_arthritis_flare, pc_pd_on, pc_pd_dose, pc_ms_heat, the SCI dysreflexia items, pc_walking_aid, pc_stand_no_hands
today.action: the day's pain and worry questions cover a flare or a new pain; the stop list keeps the dysreflexia signs and the emergency screen carries the dysreflexia screen

padAllowedWhenAll: no dizziness on standing (Parkinson's: not asked since D-032, so no pad)
leg, hip or back pain 5 or less today
pain today in another area no higher than padPainAtOrBelow
pad has a front bar, or a stable support on the side away from the phone, within reach (review B12)
comfortable speed not below the pad's lowest speed
booth or clinic staff present, or a helper at home (day_helper_ask yes)

padSafety.step: level floor, clear space behind, stop control held by helper or safety key clipped
foot sensing automatic speed off; speed set by hand
step on with the belt stopped, hold the support, start at the lowest speed, raise to comfortable
record handrail held: none, light, firm
support is a front bar, or a support on the side away from the phone; the helper stands behind the walker on the camera side
warm up 2 min (engineering default); familiarised flag only when total pad time >= 6 min

stops: person, helper or coach can stop at any time; coach stop and mark_pain end recording; the coach never overrides a safety stop (plan §3.2)
pain 6 or more, a rise of 2 or more over the score before the walk, or a sudden sharp pain ends the test; result labelled pain_limited (review A08: one shared rule)
unsteadiness, a stumble or the helper taking hold ends the test; only completed clean cycles are kept
on the pad the app cannot stop the belt: the stop line asks the person to hold the support and the helper to press stop

qualityGates.gate: one person (helper at side ok), whole body and head in view with 3% margin, phone level within 5 deg, distance in range

qualityGates.onFail: Lite; if < 20 fps, front timing only or stop

qualityGates.gate: landmarks 23 to 32 (and 11, 12 for trunk) visibility >= 0.5 in >= 90% of frames; event order valid; stride time plausible; no unresolved swap; not a turn

qualityGates.onFail: coach adds passes (overground) or 10 s (pad) once; then timing only or record again

qualityGates.gate: gap filled frames <= 15% of analysed frames

qualityGates.onFail: 20 to 24: timing only and confidence one level lower; < 20: record again

qualityGates.gate: pad and overground side: hip, knee and ankle visibility >= 0.5 in 90% of warm up frames on the near side (review B12)
qualityGates.onFail: move the support or the helper, no recording

qualityGates.gate: pad: handrail hold recorded (none, light, firm); constant speed
qualityGates.onFail: firm: trendelenburg, duchenne_lean and waddling not assessed (handrail_held), symmetry rules capped at possible; light touch: every rule capped at possible (review B12)
between limb rules capped at possible, flag far_limb (review A15, B04)

norms.lookup: ages 18 and 19 use 20 to 29 (flag); 20 to 69 Fang18; 70+ Hollman11
norms.methodWarning: speed norms differ by method: 127.2 to 146.2 cm/s 7.62 m timed walk (Bohannon97); 1.06 to 1.25 m/s 2 min sensor walk (Fang18); about 1.0 to 1.16 m/s 4 m walk Singapore (Yang24). Fang walked back and forth on 7 m, so many strides were near a turn, while Azm analyses steady steps: Azm's healthy users will look faster and longer stepping than Fang's 'typical', so slow_speed and short steps (a) under call below 70; Fang 60 to 69 (men step 0.62 m, speed 1.12) sits below Hollman 70 to 74 (0.69 m, 1.17) (review B10). Planned replacement: Oberg 1993 (233 adults 10 to 79, 5.5 m walkway, slow, normal and fast, 95% prediction intervals) and Al-Obaidi 2003 (Kuwait, 20 to 29) as the regional check; their tables were not retrieved (abstracts opened). Re-anchor on Azm healthy recordings.

fang18.population: 292 healthy adults, Nanjing, China; APDM sensors; 2 min back and forth on 7 m at comfortable speed, no aids

hollman11.population: 294 adults 70+ (108 men, 186 women), GAITRite 5.6 m, two walks at self selected normal pace, no aids; height not reported

kinematics.value: to 15 deg; max 18 deg as single support starts
maximum extension between 0 and -5 deg (near straight)
10 deg hyperextension (Perry92); 3D 20.4 +/- 4.0 young, 14.3 +/- 4.4 older, 11.1 older fallers (Kerrigan01)
peaks 20.0 to 25.5 deg near toe off, 5 conditions, 18 healthy young men, mocap, zeroed at standing
paretic 6.6 (5.4), non-paretic 11.3 (5.5) deg at peak propulsion, treadmill, 5th met to greater trochanter
about 4 deg lateral drop (Perry92); frontal pelvic range 8.2 (1.7) deg healthy preferred speed; reported means 5.7 to 11.5
4.9 (1.2) deg healthy; 9.1 (2.8) deg Duchenne limp in hip OA; reported healthy 3.3 to 7.0
7.0 to 11.2 cm 70+ (Hollman11); about 8 cm older women, 10 cm older men (Pirker)

symmetry.stance: no stance cut-off opened; swing cut-off applied to single support (= opposite swing time)

norms.kinematicNote: 2D angles to vertical differ from 3D angles to the pelvis; 3D values are context until re-anchored (G§2)

downgradeOneLevelFor: pad with handrail held (timing and symmetry rules)
single side view on the pad (between limb rules capped at possible, far_limb)
side not an affected region in the history and no listed condition explains it

signs.during: static single leg stance on S

signs.rule: toward S at the duchenne_lean possible threshold

likely.requires: possible AND the static single leg stance drop on S (review B06) AND trunk lean toward S at the duchenne_lean possible threshold

signs.rule: peak toward S in >= 60% of cycles

speedRules.below0.5: unilateral capped at possible and needs a between limb difference >= 15
speedRules.unilateralCondition: absolute peak alone counts only at >= 0.8 m/s
speedRules.interimAbsoluteAlone: interim: for every walker the absolute peak alone counts only at >= 1.0 m/s; under it the pattern needs the between limb difference (below: not_assessed, slow_speed, when the peak alone is low)

likely.requires: possible on >= 60% of the side's clean cycles AND speed >= 0.6 m/s AND near limb views (both pad side views, or overground passes with each limb nearest the phone)

notAssessed: crouch_or_short_steps_on_S (5.7 or 5.11 fires on that side)

contributorRules.tight_calf: ranks first when the Pillar 1 lunge is limited
contributorRules.calf_stiffness: ranks first with an upper motor neuron condition

targets.when: likely and foot_lift_ask yes (active movement present)

contributorRules.knee_straighten_limited: Pillar 1 knee extension deficit >= 10 deg ranks first

speedRules.interimBelow0.5: interim: not assessed below 0.5 m/s (slow_speed) when the sign is seen, like stiff knee's speed rule; an unknown speed reads as too slow (no_height)

signs.rule: >= 1.13 with the short step on the other leg
value below 0 on S (thigh cannot reach the trunk line; review B14)

thresholds.bilateral: off until re-anchored on Azm healthy recordings

contributorRules.tight_hip_flexors: ranks first when the Pillar 1 thigh cannot reach the trunk line (value below 0); never from the standing test alone otherwise (review B14)

signs.rule: < age and sex mean - 2 SD (height adjusted)
>= 5 deg forward of true vertical (engineering; standing stoop is not subtracted, review B21)

any: a and c only when height is missing

targets.when: walking pad: beat 85% of today's cadence
overground: floor marks, beat at today's cadence, 'take big steps' (review C09)

copy.rules: Arabic first with complete English; حالتك الطبية; no dash characters; person first; plain words; no diagnosis or treatment claims; patterns say may suggest; contributors are possible reasons

cadence.ar: تمشي بمعدل {value} خطوة في الدقيقة، والمعتاد لمن هم في عمرك نحو {typical}.
cadence.en: You walk at {value} steps a minute. Typical for your age is about {typical}.

speed.ar: سرعة مشيك {value} متر في الثانية، والمعتاد لمن هم في عمرك نحو {typical}.
speed.en: Your walking speed is {value} metres a second. Typical for your age is about {typical}.

speed_pad.ar: اخترت على جهاز المشي سرعة {value} كيلومتر في الساعة.
speed_pad.en: You chose {value} km an hour on the walking pad.

step_length.ar: طول خطوتك نحو {value} سنتيمتر، والمعتاد لمن هم في عمرك وطولك نحو {typical}.
step_length.en: Your step is about {value} cm long. Typical for your age and height is about {typical}.

steps_even.en: Your steps are about even on both sides.

uneven_step_length.ar: خطوة ساقك {side_ar} أقصر من خطوة الساق الأخرى.
uneven_step_length.en: The step of your {side_en} leg is shorter than the step of your other leg.

slow_speed.ar: سرعة مشيك أبطأ من المعتاد لمن هم في عمرك.
slow_speed.en: Your walking speed is slower than typical for your age.

antalgic.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أنك تقف على ساقك {side_ar} وقتًا أقصر من الساق الأخرى.
antalgic.en: Your walk may suggest that you stand on your {side_en} leg for a shorter time than on your other leg.

short_stance.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أنك تقف على ساقك {side_ar} وقتًا أقصر من الساق الأخرى.
short_stance.en: Your walk may suggest that you stand on your {side_en} leg for a shorter time than on your other leg.

trendelenburg.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن حوضك ينخفض في الجهة الأخرى عندما تقف على ساقك {side_ar}.
trendelenburg.en: Your walk may suggest that your hips dip on the other side when you stand on your {side_en} leg.

duchenne_lean.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أنك تميل بجذعك نحو ساقك {side_ar} عندما تقف عليها.
duchenne_lean.en: Your walk may suggest that you lean your upper body over your {side_en} leg when you stand on it.

waddling.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن حوضك وجذعك يتمايلان من جهة إلى أخرى.
waddling.en: Your walk may suggest that your hips and upper body sway from side to side.

stiff_knee.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتك {side_ar} تنثني أقل من المعتاد عندما تحرك ساقك إلى الأمام.
stiff_knee.en: Your walk may suggest that your {side_en} knee bends less than usual when you swing your leg forward.

stiff_knee_both.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتيك تنثنيان أقل من المعتاد عندما تحرك ساقيك إلى الأمام.
stiff_knee_both.en: Your walk may suggest that both knees bend less than usual when you swing your legs forward.

steppage_possible.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن مقدمة قدمك {side_ar} تلمس الأرض قبل الكعب أو معه.
steppage_possible.en: Your walk may suggest that the front of your {side_en} foot lands before your heel or with it.

steppage_likely.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أنك ترفع ساقك {side_ar} أعلى من المعتاد، وأن مقدمة قدمك تلمس الأرض أولًا.
steppage_likely.en: Your walk may suggest that you lift your {side_en} leg higher than usual and that the front of your foot lands first.

crouch.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتيك تبقيان منثنيتين وأنت تقف على كل ساق.
crouch.en: Your walk may suggest that your knees stay bent while you stand on each leg.

knee_stays_bent.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتك {side_ar} تبقى منثنية عندما تقف عليها.
knee_stays_bent.en: Your walk may suggest that your {side_en} knee stays bent when you stand on it.

recurvatum.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتك {side_ar} تنثني إلى الخلف أبعد من وضعها المستقيم عندما تقف عليها.
recurvatum.en: Your walk may suggest that your {side_en} knee bends backwards past straight when you stand on it.

quad_avoidance.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ركبتك {side_ar} تبقى مستقيمة تقريبًا عندما تضع قدمك على الأرض.
quad_avoidance.en: Your walk may suggest that your {side_en} knee stays almost straight as your foot lands.

reduced_extension.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن ساقك {side_ar} لا تمتد خلفك كثيرًا قبل أن ترفعها.
reduced_extension.en: Your walk may suggest that your {side_en} leg does not reach far behind you before you lift it.

short_steps.ar: قد تشير طريقة مشيك إلى أن خطواتك أقصر من المعتاد بالنسبة لسرعتك وعمرك.
short_steps.en: Your walk may suggest that your steps are shorter than usual for your speed and age.

possible_suffix.ar: وسنتحقق من ذلك مرة أخرى في القياس القادم.
possible_suffix.en: We will check this again at your next check.

no_pattern.ar: لم نلحظ اليوم في مشيك نمطًا يحتاج إلى تمارين خاصة، من الأنماط التي يبحث عنها هذا القياس.
no_pattern.en: We did not see a walking pattern today that needs special exercises, among the patterns this check looks for.

pain_side.ar: الألم الذي ذكرته في هذه الجهة
pain_side.en: the pain you told us about on that side

weak_stance_leg.ar: ضعف هذه الساق أو صعوبة الوقوف عليها
weak_stance_leg.en: weakness in that leg, or finding it harder to stand on it

weak_hip_abductors.en: weaker muscles on the side of your hip

hip_girdle_weakness.ar: ضعف عضلات الورك والفخذ في الجهتين
hip_girdle_weakness.en: weaker hip and thigh muscles on both sides

weak_push_off.ar: ضعف الدفع من عضلات خلف الساق
weak_push_off.en: a weaker push from your calf muscles

quad_stiffness.ar: تيبّس عضلات مقدمة الفخذ المرتبط بحالتك الطبية
quad_stiffness.en: stiffness in the muscles at the front of your thigh that can come with your medical condition

weak_hip_flexors.en: weaker muscles at the front of your hip

clearance_compensation.ar: محاولة إبعاد القدم عن الأرض بتحريك الساق إلى الجانب أو رفع الورك
clearance_compensation.en: trying to clear your foot by swinging the leg out or lifting the hip

weak_dorsiflexors.ar: ضعف العضلات التي ترفع مقدمة القدم
weak_dorsiflexors.en: weaker muscles that lift the front of your foot

calf_stiffness.ar: تيبّس عضلات خلف الساق المرتبط بحالتك الطبية
calf_stiffness.en: stiffness in your calf muscles that can come with your medical condition

weak_quadriceps.en: weaker muscles at the front of your thigh

weak_hamstrings.en: weaker muscles at the back of your thigh

tight_hip_flexors.en: tight muscles at the front of your hip

small_movements_condition.ar: صغر الحركة وبطؤها المرتبطان بحالتك الطبية
small_movements_condition.en: smaller and slower movements that can come with your medical condition

careful_walking.ar: المشي بحذر بعد سقوط أو خوفًا من السقوط
careful_walking.en: walking carefully after a fall, or for fear of falling

prosthesis_fit.en: the length or set up of your prosthesis

prosthesis_comfort.ar: مدى راحة الطرف الصناعي وثقتك بالوقوف عليه
prosthesis_comfort.en: how comfortable your prosthesis feels and how sure you feel standing on it

targetsLead.en: So we added {list} to your program.

strengthen_hip_abductors.en: exercises to strengthen the muscles on the side of your hip

strengthen_hip_extensors.en: exercises to strengthen your buttock muscles

strengthen_quadriceps.en: exercises to strengthen the front of your thigh

strengthen_hamstrings.en: exercises to strengthen the back of your thigh

strengthen_calf_push_off.ar: تمارين تقوّي عضلات خلف الساق وتدريبًا على الدفع بالقدم
strengthen_calf_push_off.en: exercises to strengthen your calf muscles and practice pushing off

strengthen_hip_flexors.en: exercises to strengthen the front of your hip

strengthen_dorsiflexors.en: exercises that lift the front of your foot

stretch_hip_flexors.en: stretches for the front of your hip

stretch_hamstrings.en: stretches for the back of your thigh

mobility_knee_flexion.ar: تمارين تثني فيها ركبتك ضمن المدى المريح
mobility_knee_flexion.en: exercises that bend your knee within a comfortable range

mobility_knee_extension.ar: تمارين تفرد فيها ركبتك ضمن المدى المريح
mobility_knee_extension.en: exercises that straighten your knee within a comfortable range

gentle_range_load.ar: حركات لطيفة لمدى الحركة، وتحميلًا تدريجيًا بقدر ما يريحك
gentle_range_load.en: gentle range of motion, and gradual loading as you feel comfortable

single_leg_practice.ar: تدريبًا على الوقوف على ساق واحدة مع سند
single_leg_practice.en: practice standing on one leg with support

knee_control_practice.ar: تدريبًا على التحكم في الركبة وأنت واقف
knee_control_practice.en: practice controlling your knee while standing

loading_practice.ar: تدريبًا على ثني الركبة قليلًا وأنت تحمل وزنك مع سند
loading_practice.en: practice bending your knee a little while taking your weight, with support

step_length_pad_practice.ar: تدريبًا على خطوات أطول مع إيقاع على جهاز المشي
step_length_pad_practice.en: practice taking longer steps to a beat on the walking pad

gradual_loading_practice.ar: تدريبًا على تحميل وزنك على الساق خطوة بخطوة
gradual_loading_practice.en: practice putting your weight on the leg step by step

refer_afo.ar: قد يفيدك أن تسأل فريق رعايتك عن دعامة للقدم والكاحل.
refer_afo.en: You may want to ask your care team about an ankle and foot brace.

refer_knee_brace.ar: قد يفيدك أن تسأل فريق رعايتك عن دعامة تمنع ركبتك من الانثناء إلى الخلف.
refer_knee_brace.en: You may want to ask your care team about a brace that stops your knee bending backwards.

refer_prosthetist.ar: قد يفيدك أن تراجع أخصائي الأطراف الصناعية للتأكد من طول الطرف وضبطه.
refer_prosthetist.en: You may want to see your prosthetist to check the length and set up of your prosthesis.

refer_new_or_worse.ar: إذا كان هذا جديدًا أو يزداد، فراجع طبيبك قريبًا.
refer_new_or_worse.en: If this is new or getting worse, please see your doctor soon.

refer_care_team.ar: نقترح أن تعرض هذه النتيجة على فريق رعايتك.
refer_care_team.en: We suggest you show this result to your care team.

quality_retry.ar: لم نتمكن من رؤية خطواتك بوضوح كافٍ. لنجرّب مرة أخرى مع إضاءة أفضل والهاتف ثابت.
quality_retry.en: We could not see your steps clearly enough. Let us try again with better light and the phone steady.

quality_timing_only.ar: رأينا توقيت خطواتك بوضوح، لكننا لم نتمكن من قياس حركة ركبتيك ووركيك هذه المرة.
quality_timing_only.en: We saw the timing of your steps clearly, but we could not measure how your knees and hips move this time.

pad_compare.ar: قسنا مشيك على جهاز المشي، وسنقارنه في المرة القادمة بقياس على الجهاز أيضًا.
pad_compare.en: We measured your walk on the walking pad, and next time we will compare it with another walking pad check.

handrail_held.ar: أمسكت بالمقبض أثناء المشي، لذلك قد تبدو خطواتك أكثر انتظامًا مما هي عليه دون مقبض، ولم نقيّم حركة حوضك وجذعك هذه المرة.
handrail_held.en: You held the handrail while walking, so your steps may look more even than they are without it, and we did not assess how your hips and upper body move this time.

handrail_light.ar: لمست المقبض بخفة أثناء المشي، لذلك نعرض نتائجك بدرجة تأكد أقل.
handrail_light.en: You touched the handrail lightly while walking, so we show your results with less certainty.

pain_limited.ar: توقفنا لأنك شعرت بألم، وسجلنا ذلك مع نتيجتك.
pain_limited.en: We stopped because you felt pain, and we noted this with your result.

aid_noted.en: We measured your walk while you used your {aid_en}.

helper_needed.ar: نحتاج أن يمشي بجانبك شخص بالغ أثناء اختبار المشي.
helper_needed.en: We need another adult to walk beside you during the walking test.

pc_walk_10m.ar: هل تستطيع أن تمشي عشرة أمتار على أرض مستوية دون أن يمسكك أحد؟
pc_walk_10m.en: Can you walk 10 metres on a flat floor without someone holding you?

pc_pd_freezing.ar: هل تشعر أحيانًا بأن قدميك ملتصقتان بالأرض عندما تبدأ المشي أو تستدير؟
pc_pd_freezing.en: Do your feet sometimes feel stuck to the floor when you start walking or turn?

clear_path.ar: تأكد أن الطريق خالٍ ومستوٍ، وأن بقربك شيئًا ثابتًا تستند إليه.
clear_path.en: Make sure the path is clear and level, with something steady to hold nearby.

usual_aid.ar: امشِ كما تمشي عادة، مع عصاك أو المشاية أو الدعامة إن كنت تستخدمها.
usual_aid.en: Walk as you usually do, with your cane, walker or brace if you use one.

turn_slowly.ar: عند نهاية الطريق، استدر ببطء في نصف دائرة واسعة.
turn_slowly.en: At the end of the path, turn slowly in a wide half circle.

pad_auto_off.ar: أوقف خاصية تغيير السرعة بالقدم، واضبط السرعة يدويًا.
pad_auto_off.en: Turn off the foot speed control and set the speed by hand.

pad_key.ar: ثبّت مفتاح الأمان بملابسك إن كان في الجهاز مفتاح.
pad_key.en: Clip the safety key to your clothes if the pad has one.

pad_start.ar: قف على الجهاز وهو متوقف وأنت ممسك بالسند، ثم ابدأ بأبطأ سرعة وزدها حتى تصل إلى مشيك المريح.
pad_start.en: Step on while the belt is stopped and hold the support. Then start at the slowest speed and raise it until it feels like your comfortable walk.

stop_any_time.ar: توقف في أي وقت إذا شعرت بألم أو دوخة أو عدم ثبات.
stop_any_time.en: Stop at any time if you feel pain or dizziness, or feel unsteady.

pad_stop.en: Hold the support, and your helper will stop the pad.

pad_other_side.ar: الآن ينقل مرافقك الهاتف إلى الجهة الأخرى من جهاز المشي والجهاز متوقف. ثم ابدأ من جديد بالسرعة نفسها.
pad_other_side.en: Now your helper moves the phone to the other side of the walking pad while the belt is stopped. Then start again at the same speed.

walk_past_phone.ar: امشِ متجاوزًا الهاتف دون أن تبطئ، ثم توقف عند العلامة خلفه.
walk_past_phone.en: Walk past the phone without slowing down, then stop at the mark behind it.

single_leg_static.ar: أمسك السند بأطراف أصابعك، وقف على ساق واحدة حتى 10 ثوان، ثم بدّل الساق. توقف متى شئت.
single_leg_static.en: Rest your fingertips on the support and stand on one leg for up to 10 seconds, then change legs. Stop whenever you want.
